content:
“Today's skill, yesterday's style!”

**Modern Renegade** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Gain Pistol hip fire accuracy and a increased chance to cripple a limb

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Small guns gain +30% hip fire accuracy and +75% limb damage. | 00054DF2 | 
| ★★ | 2 | Small guns gain +20% hip fire accuracy and +50% limb damage. | 0000EE1E | 
| ★ | 1 | Small guns gain +10% hip fire accuracy and +25% limb damage. | 0000EE1C | 

- Update 62 reduced hip fire accuracy bonus from 15%/30%/45% to 10%/20%/30%.
- Prior to patch 1.4.0.20, the Adventure mode variant of Modern Renegade had a 2%, 3%, and 4% chance to cripple limbs at each respective rank.
